title: Does the crash-test rating cover the car you are buying?
search_intent: Verify applicability of an advertised safety rating to an imported vehicle before relying on it in selection.
buyer_task: Accept the rating claim, request missing unit evidence, or reject unsupported transfer.
vehicle_identity_lock: N/A: methodology guide; illustrative vehicles explicitly scoped per facts
representative_countries: Not a regional import-rule guide; Europe program, Australian example, US programs kept separate

facts.claim: Dual standard/optional ratings; test-year relevance and up-to-six-year validity.
Units built during rating validity retain rating; later new production unrated; independent evaluation not regulatory permission.
Australian FWD BEV; from 21 November 2022 after VIN LGXCE4CBXN2131695; May 2022+ earlier units eligible after specified brand updates; earlier unupdated units unrated; NZ separate.
Historical announcement confirms child restraint changes and earlier-unit eligibility after updates.
IIHS itself determines carryover/extension; BEV variants tested separately.
2025 award listing: 2025–26 Hyundai Elantra sedan only built after October 2024; body/year/build restrictions matter.
Frontal and overall comparison restricted to same class and within 250 pounds; side and rollover comparisons broader; not rated differs from poor rating; warnings coexist with high score.
